title: Gross–Zagier formulas and arithmetic heights, Part II: unitary cycles and the AFL
summary: Extend the point-height and Shimura-curve Gross–Zagier direction to higher-dimensional unitary special cycles. Organize unramified, almost self-dual, exotic smooth and Krämer intersection identities, the arithmetic Siegel–Weil formulas, and the global-to-local proof of the strongly regular arithmetic fundamental lemma. Keep exact residue sizes, duality conventions and measure factors, and expose source proof obligations and shared-foundation extensions.
readme: The authoritative reader is research/blueprint/readmes/GrossZagierAndArithmeticHeightsPartII.md. Fifteen layers separate the local models, strata, Fourier identities, global special and fat CM cycles, and two global comparison arguments. Independent inner-product, GSpin, p-adic and higher-Green continuations are allocated in the split proposals. Generic lattices, supported K theory, Fourier analysis and good-prime PEL theory are imported from their existing owners.

stages.title: Unramified special cycles and derived intersections
stages.description: Over an odd-residue-characteristic unramified quadratic local extension, define liftability cycles on the signature (1,n−1) Rapoport–Zink functor, their derived classes and Euler intersections. Prove Cartierness, basis independence, proper full-rank support, cancellation and the rank-one normalization. Generic formal K theory and the RZ representability input are imported contracts.

stages.title: Unramified strata and horizontal cycles
stages.description: Identify odd-type vertex strata with unitary Deligne–Lusztig varieties, their incidence and special-cycle support. Classify primitive horizontal cycles by type-at-most-one overlattices, prove Tate-module lifting criteria and compute quasi-canonical degrees; give low-rank vertical checks.

stages.title: Tate classes and local modularity
stages.description: Calculate Frobenius eigenspaces on unitary Deligne–Lusztig strata, prove boundary generation of Tate classes and numerical reduction of vertical intersections to curves. Establish curve Fourier identities, corrected Chern-character formulas and higher K-theoretic local modularity without an unjustified global formal filtration theorem.

stages.title: Unramified analytic and local identities
stages.description: Import normalized unramified Siegel polynomials and their overlattice formula. Define horizontal and vertical density functions, prove analytic regularity and the restricted negative-norm Fourier vanishing, and close the local identity by induction on the difference and an uncertainty principle. Normalize the Whittaker derivative explicitly.

stages.title: Almost self-dual comparison
stages.description: Define original almost self-dual Y-cycles and auxiliary pulled-back cycles separately. Prove the finite-flat exceptional-divisor comparison using Li–Rapoport–Zhang’s model theorem, identify the two model conventions, and derive both local density identities including the correction term and degree q+1.

stages.title: Exotic smooth geometry
stages.description: For even rank and ramified quadratic extensions, use the exotic smooth RZ model with its scaled special Hom form and trace duality. Define the zero-vector Koszul complex and modular line, prove linear invariance and Cartierness, describe even-type strata and their Tate classes, and compute the rank-two and component normalizations.

stages.title: Exotic analytic formula and induction
stages.description: Consume ramified trace-dual density polynomials and their finite overlattice formula. Define analytic and geometric horizontal/vertical parts, prove the lattice-extension cancellation and Fourier bounds, and close the exotic local identity with the special two-overlattice induction. Export the relative/absolute cycle comparison.

stages.title: Krämer model geometry and horizontal correction
stages.description: On the ramified Krämer model of either hermitian sign, construct special cycles, type-zero exceptional projective spaces and positive-type symplectic incidence strata. Prove the corrected incidence relations and deformation properties, classify horizontal lattices and define the exceptional-line correction in the graded derived cycle. Establish the parity-corrected cancellation and geometric Fourier bounds.

stages.title: Krämer density correction and proof obligation
stages.description: Import ramified density polynomials with −2 derivative normalization and the uniquely determined dual-vertex correction coefficients. State primitive density products, analytic partial-integral bounds and the horizontal identity. Isolate the false negative-norm vanishing and the missing isolated odd-top induction case; the full Krämer identity is a target with this explicit proof gap.

stages.title: Local AFL geometry and rank reduction
stages.description: Define strongly regular group and semi-Lie intersections on unramified RZ spaces, their proper support and orbit invariance. Compare graph pullbacks through the relative Cayley map, prove rank and norm-unit reductions with residue-size bounds, and prove fixed-g and joint local constancy using higher local modularity. Import the distinct Jacquet–Rallis analytic transfer contract.

stages.title: Global special cycles and local degrees
stages.description: Construct generic and integral unitary KR cycles and their derived K-classes on the source-admissible RSZ models, identify uniformizations and local Euler sums with their log-residue and reflex-degree normalizations, and compare with Li–Liu’s cycle interfaces. Keep the integral model hypotheses explicit at every bad place.

stages.title: Fat CM and derived Hecke cycles
stages.description: Define the possibly nonmaximal CM order, twisted fat CM moduli and their derived Hecke realization. Prove finite unramified forgetfulness, properness, good-order étaleness, characteristic-polynomial decomposition and formal orbit uniformization; realize the derived class as a proper one-cycle via its virtual filtration, without asserting actual dimension one.

stages.title: Modular divisors, Green functions and AFL pairings
stages.description: Construct Chow and arithmetic-divisor series with their nonzero and Hodge-line constant terms, complex orbit formulas and Green metrics. Prove the source-scoped modularity and Green comparison over Q, pair with the proper derived CM one-cycle, and derive finite inert and archimedean orbit formulas with the correct factor two and normalization.

stages.title: Arithmetic Siegel–Weil identities
stages.description: Specialize the unitary Siegel section and incoherent Diff-set factorization, state source-admissible global model conditions, and prove semi-global and global coefficient identities. Construct Green star products and arithmetic degrees with the half-archimedean normalization. State the unramified full formula and the modified ramified formula with its inherited Krämer proof obligation.

stages.title: Global comparison and strongly regular AFL
stages.description: Consume source-scoped Jacquet–Rallis transfer, Gaussian and fundamental-lemma inputs; define the corrected holomorphic derivative and compare it with the modular CM series over Q. Separate local logarithms, isolate a strongly regular orbit and perform the final induction for the published Q_p range. Record the q=n Cayley boundary proof obligation and retain arbitrary regular semisimple AFL only as a conjecture.
